description: Data payload shape of 'system.converge' (envelope.data) — the update-pipeline equivalent (docs/GUI-ARCHITECTURE-PROPOSAL.md section 2.3). Steps replay manage.sh's run_apply_steps order; non-fatal steps (secrets pull) degrade to warnings.

dry_run.description: true when the run only previewed changes.

steps.description: Per-step execution results, in pipeline order.

snapshot.description: Pre-write snapshot echo covering all converged domains, or null in dry-run mode.

link_count.description: Symlink entries recorded in the manifest.

skipped.description: Steps the pipeline skipped by policy (names only), always present.

exit_code.description: Process exit code (124 = timeout, 127 = spawn failure).
